introduction: WOOKTOOL snap-off utility knives support hardware, stationery, DIY and retail programs that need a compact cutter with a replaceable segmented blade direction. Buyers can compare blade format, lock behavior and packaging before choosing a model for a branded order.

Customization discussions can cover logo, handle color, blade width, retail pack, barcode and carton mark. The selected cutter should be reviewed for the intended user, target shelf channel and local product requirements.
A useful RFQ includes the preferred blade width, target market, quantity, branding requirement, package format and any reference product or artwork.

faq.question: What is a snap-off utility knife used for?
faq.answer: Snap-off cutters are commonly considered for light cutting tasks in stationery, DIY, hardware and retail programs. Confirm the target material and blade width with the supplier.

faq.question: Can I specify the blade width?
faq.answer: Yes. State the blade-width direction and intended use in the RFQ so the factory can confirm a suitable model and blade option.

faq.question: Can the snap-off cutter be sold under a private label?
faq.answer: Yes. Logo, handle color, blister card, color box, barcode and carton marks can be reviewed for private-label orders.

faq.question: What function checks should be included?
faq.answer: Checks can cover blade fit, sliding track, auto-lock behavior, blade extension, handle appearance and finished packaging.

faq.question: Can the packaging be customized for retail?
faq.answer: Yes. Retail packaging direction can be discussed with artwork, barcode and carton requirements for the destination market.
